response.text: Invoice 328 is confirmed: the AP invoice says 14,357.03 but its journal posts 14,339.03 to both sides. Invoice 802 is a credit memo whose journal correctly reverses sign, so it's not a ledger error. I have enough to submit.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT h."JRNL_NO", SUM(l."DR_AMT") AS dr, SUM(l."CR_AMT") AS cr FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLJRNL" l ON l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" GROUP BY h."JRNL_NO" HAVING SUM(l."DR_AMT")<>SUM(l."CR_AMT")
findings.summary: Journal 1075 is out of balance: DR 6654.87 vs CR 6663.87 (difference 9.00). This is the only unbalanced journal and accounts for the total 9.00 gap between all debits and credits.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT i."INV_ID", i."VEND_CD", i."INV_NO", i."INV_AMT", i."JRNL_NO" FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."INV_ID" IN (249,801)
findings.summary: Vendor V0018 invoice 'V0018-47982-249' is recorded twice: INV_ID 249 (journal 1409) and INV_ID 801 (journal 2469), same vendor, same amount 14704.74, same date 20240402. The invoice number differs only by a trailing space on the second record. Both are in period 4 and both are live.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."JRNL_NO", l."LN_SEQ", l."ACCT_CD", l."DR_AMT", l."CR_AMT" FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "GLJRNL" l ON l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" WHERE i."INV_ID"=328
findings.summary: AP invoice INV_ID 328 is recorded at 14357.03 in APINVH, but its journal 1544 posts only 14339.03 to the expense and AP control accounts. The 18.00 difference means the subledger and GL disagree.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT l."JRNL_NO", l."LN_SEQ", l."ACCT_CD" FROM "GLJRNL" l LEFT JOIN "GLCOA" c ON TRIM(c."ACCT_CD")=TRIM(l."ACCT_CD") WHERE c."ACCT_CD" IS NULL
findings.summary: Journal 1979 line 1 posts to ACCT_CD '5950', which does not exist in the chart of accounts (GLCOA).

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT h."JRNL_NO", h."POST_DT", p."PRD_ID", p."STAT_CD", p."CLOSE_DT" FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" WHERE p."STAT_CD"='C' AND h."POST_DT" > p."CLOSE_DT"
findings.summary: Journal 2470 (source GL) is dated 20241116 in period 10, which is closed (CLOSE_DT 20241105), so the posting falls after the period closed. Needs authorisation review.
